engines.notes: VERIFICATION 2026-10-10 (every URL cited was opened that day unless marked inferred): google.com/search returned a CAPTCHA ('unusual traffic') to headless Chromium and HTTP 403 to curl from this network, so Google parameters were verified against documents, not live result diffs. Opened and checked: Google CSE XML reference (q, start, num, hl, gl, lr, cr, safe, filter, ie, oe, as_q/as_epq/as_oq/as_eq/as_nlo/as_nhi/as_qdr/as_sitesearch/as_dt/as_lq/as_filetype/as_rights, imgsz/imgtype/imgc/imgcolor all present; as_rq absent, so its source is now SerpApi); live google.com/advanced_search form (as_q, as_epq, as_eq, as_sitesearch, as_filetype, as_qdr, lr, cr, tbs, authuser; licence packed into tbs via data-tbs=true); advanced image form (now /advanced_search?udm=2: as_st=y, tbm=isch, imgsz, imgar, cr, as_filetype, tbs carrying isc/ic/itp/sur); Chromium prepopulated_engines.json (search_intent_params si, gs_ssp, udm; alternate_urls) and template_url.cc (replacement params clid, client, gp, gs_lcrp, gs_rn, hl, oq, pf, psi, rlz, source, sourceid); SearXNG google*.py; SerpApi google.ts; ClearURLs and AdGuard rules; Firefox search-config-v2 (client, channel). No functional parameter was demoted; no non-functional one was promoted. Source corrections: as_rq (SerpApi, not CSE); udm gains the advanced_image_search redirect as evidence; num gains SearXNG's 'no effect' comment. All 3 tests pass the reference cleaner built from these keep-lists. Keep-list: q, start, num, tbm, udm, hl, gl, lr, cr, safe, tbs, filter, nfpr, pws, every as_*, imgsz/imgar/imgc/imgcolor/imgtype, ijn, si, gs_ssp, kgmid, uule, ludocid, lsig, ibp, htidocid, plus ie only when not UTF-8. Not added: CSE-only hq (appends terms), c2coff (Chinese variants) and sort, because they belong to Programmable Search (cse.google.com) rather than google.com/search; unknown names are dropped by default. Fragments #imgrc=, #vhid=, #lrd= select an item inside the page (inferred); #q= carries the query on /webhp and /. Google Lens result pages (/search?vsrid=...&lns_mode=...&udm=26) depend on session ids and cannot be canonicalised (inferred). ClearURLs also strips 'site' and 'ie' unconditionally; 'site' is not a /search parameter. Out of scope but related: news.google.com (hl, gl, ceid functional) and scholar.google.com (q, start, hl, as_sdt, as_vis, as_ylo, as_yhi per SearXNG google_scholar.py).

engines.notes: VERIFICATION 2026-10-10 (every URL cited was opened that day unless marked inferred): Bing answered curl, but web and image/video result lists from a script are unreliable (a dummy parameter alone gave Jaccard 0.00 on images and videos, and web filters returned unrelated filler), so live diffs were taken on /news/search, which was stable (three dummy variants identical). Confirmed live: q, first (news), count (news), setlang, cc, mkt, setmkt, adlt, qft (news), nvaug, ubiroff, format=rss; confirmed from Bing's own links: filters, qft for images and videos, view/id/mediaurl/mid, webscp. Confirmed non-functional live on news: cvid, sid, PC, FORM/form. Changes from the first pass: ubiroff and webscp moved to functional; setmkt upgraded from inferred to observed; sid and mcid added to non-functional; Chromium source corrected (FORM=CHROMI on the image-upload URL, no PC in the current file); test 3 replaced with a news URL that exercises the live-verified parameters (the images test from the first pass still holds: keep q, qft, first, setlang, cc). Preserve raw encoding of qft and filters (qft uses + as a literal separator; filters carries quoted values); never re-encode. Old SearXNG sent FORM=PERE/PERE<n> and pq with first because automated paging was unreliable without them, and AdGuard commented out '$removeparam=FORM,domain=bing.com' after issue 215377 (blank pages with in-browser rewriting). An offline cleaner loads the URL once, so dropping FORM is fine; first=11 alone could not be confirmed on web because Bing ignores paging for scripted clients. SearXNG maps 'day' to interval="4" (past hour) deliberately; its docstring says the difference between last day and last week is marginal (first pass called this a bug; corrected). API-only names (offset, freshness, safeSearch, responseFilter, answerCount, promote, textDecorations, textFormat) belong to the retired Bing Web Search API v7, not bing.com URLs; treat as unknown (dropped). Visual-search pages (iss=sbi or cbir=sbi with imgurl) depend on an uploaded image and are not canonicalisable (inferred).

engines.notes: VERIFICATION 2026-10-10 (every URL cited was opened that day unless marked inferred): search.yahoo.com, news.search.yahoo.com and video.search.yahoo.com served results to curl once a cookie jar followed the /_bv/v.gif 307 hop (the first pass reported curl failing). Each variant used a fresh cookie jar and was compared on the organic list (ads, Bing click links and Yahoo-internal links removed); dummy-free baselines were stable. Confirmed live: p, b, btf, vm (via URL), vs, durs, vage. Not confirmed live but kept as plausibly functional with notes: pz, n, vl, fl, vc, vf, image filters (images host returned HTTP 500), vres, vsite. Confirmed non-functional live: fr, fr2, ei=UTF-8, fp, iscqry, bct, xargs, pstart. Corrections: SearXNG sends vm, vl and fl in the sB preference cookie, not as URL parameters, so the first pass's SearXNG citation for them as URL parameters was imprecise (SerpApi and the live vm test carry them now); Yahoo web pages show 7 organic results per page, so page 2 is b=8 (b=11 still works as an offset); pstart added to non-functional; test 2 gains pstart; test 3 now uses a video URL with live-verified filters (the first pass's images test still holds under these rules: keep p, imgsz, imgty, imgl). Strip ;_ylt=/;_ylu=/;_ylc= path segments before query processing (they sit between the path and '?'). DataForSEO claims tbs=qdr: and vm=0/1 for Yahoo; not adopted. Yahoo! JAPAN (search.yahoo.co.jp) is a different engine: p query, ei encoding (conditional), b offset; fr and frtype are tracking per AdGuard and Firefox (fr=mozff).

engines.notes: VERIFICATION 2026-10-10 (every URL cited was opened that day unless marked inferred): yandex.com/search, yandex.ru and ya.ru served a CAPTCHA to curl, but yandex.com.tr/search, yandex.com/images/search and yandex.com/video/search served full pages, so web parameters were tested on yandex.com.tr and image parameters on yandex.com. Yandex Images exposes its own filter definition (advancedSearch.filters.order = isize, iorient, type, icolor, itype, recent, site) and echoes recognised URL filters in advancedSearch.filters.active, which gave a direct test of each name. Web comparisons used the external organic list; dummy-parameter baselines were identical, with one recurring alternative backend variant (Jaccard 0.82) treated as noise. Confirmed live: text, p, lr, rstr, lang, within (77, and 777 with bounds), isize/iw/ih, iorient, icolor, type, itype, recent, site (images and web), family (images), duration (video). Kept with notes: numdoc (not honoured), nomisspell, noreask, ento, promo=force_neuro, hd, rpt/img_url/pos. Confirmed non-functional live: clid, from, source-serpid, parent-reqid. Corrections: type = image kind and itype = file format (reverse of the old client); color and commercial are not recognised and moved to non-functional; lang and within work on the main SERP, while SearXNG uses them on /search/site/; from no longer appears in Chromium's Yandex definition; source, parent-reqid, stype and rnd added as non-functional; ento, promo (force_neuro only) and img_url/pos added as functional; test 3 extended with type, itype, parent-reqid and source. Decision needed on lr: test 1 assumes CheckLink keeps it as functional. If CheckLink follows ClearURLs on privacy grounds, the expected clean URL becomes https://yandex.ru/search/?text=bag; Yandex re-adds lr from the recipient's own IP on load, so stripping costs only the sharer's region choice. The Yandex Search API reference (yandex.cloud, now aistudio.yandex.ru) reset connections from this network and the Wayback Machine rate-limited, so lr rests on SerpApi's copy of Yandex's wording plus the live tests.
